content_zh: 听到唐音稚嫩的声音，很多人当场就不好了。　　你哥哥很厉害？　　就你哥哥进来时的那样子，半死不活的，你说他很厉害谁信？　　也不看看他的对手是谁？　　那是三元及第的状元唐画，还有刚刚金榜题名的一众士子才子。　　他一个人还能是这么多人的对手？　　结果，唐逸一上台两首词当场将所有人给打趴下了！　　此时看着一脸得意的唐音，众人一阵咬牙，原来这小丫头进来的时候说哥哥很厉害，真不是吹牛，只是在阐述一个事实而已。　　他哥哥，的确很厉害！　　“对，你哥哥很厉害，谁都不是对手。”　　杜凌菲揉了揉唐音的脑袋，也是笑了起来。　　她之前也对唐逸没那么有信心，现在看来是白担心了。　　他说得没错，他出手，别人连出手的机会都没有了。　　这不是狂妄！　　是事实。　　而此时，炎文帝目光扫过全场，目光冷冽，额上的青筋都凸起了。　　看上去，他已经怒不可遏。　　实际上，他不是愤怒，是快憋不住笑了。　　虽然实际情况和他的猜测，有一定的出入，但这出入对他来说……那是好事啊！　　虽然当日被唐画一首《劝谏诗》整得狼狈不堪，但现在看到唐敬，刘温，赵柯等大臣那惶恐不安，连看都不敢看他的样子……　　他心头就没有愤怒了，只剩下畅爽！　　哈哈，看到了吗？这就是朕看中的小诗仙，是朕看中的人。　　你们不是很狂？你们不是喜欢怼朕吗？　　连你们怼朕的诗词，都是出自朕的小诗仙，你们狂妄什么？！　　哈哈哈……忍住，忍住，朕是经过训练的，必须忍住不笑。　　除非忍不住！　　“哈哈哈……”　　炎文帝的笑声，传遍全场。　　然而，听到他的笑声，全场瞬间鸦雀无声。　　他的笑声太魔性，魔性到让人恐惧。　　特别是刘温，赵柯等一众大臣，瞬间头皮发麻，完了，陛下生气了。　　炎文帝嘴角带笑，看向唐画冷声道：“唐画，朕只问你一次……殿试的诗，是不是抄袭唐逸的？”　　唐画早就被炎文帝的笑声吓到了。　　扑通！　　他膝盖一软，当场跪在了地上，连连磕头。　　“陛下恕罪，陛下饶命，臣……臣一时鬼迷心窍，用了唐逸的诗词。”　　“陛下开恩，臣再也不敢了……”　　哈哈，果然是真的，还真是唐逸那小子的诗词。　　啧啧，既然如此那朕就不客气了啊！　　当日你们那群老贼怎么欺朕的，朕今日就怎么还给你们。　　咳，不能太高兴，得装得生气一点……炎文帝缓缓抬头，凝望苍穹。　　众人看到他的样子，吓得大气不敢出。　　片刻，炎文帝一甩衣袖，冰冷的声音在空气中传开。　　“好，好得很！”　　炎文帝目光盯着刘温和唐敬一群大臣，道：“刘爱卿，唐爱卿，你们玩得一出好戏啊！把朕玩得团团转。”　　“好一个能堪比朕的小诗仙的大状元，好一个能写《劝谏诗》的天纵奇才！”　　“呵呵，你们如此戏弄朕，真以为朕不敢杀你们吗？”　　炎文帝所说的每一个字，都像是巴掌一般甩在了唐敬和刘温一众大臣的脸上。　　刘温唐敬等一众大臣瞬间全都跪了下来，全都被吓得脸色煞白。　　“臣等万死，陛下恕罪！”　　炎文帝目光冷冷地盯着他们，嘲讽一笑。　　“万死？你们怎么会该死呢？该死的是朕啊！”　　“你们当日可是拿着一首抄袭的《劝谏诗》，逼着朕和北狄和谈，说得正义凛然，理直气壮”　　“朕要不听，那就是昏君，就是不顾江山社稷。”　　“你们都是忠臣，怎么会万死呢……一死，就行了！”　　后面的话，炎文帝咬得极重。　　刘温，赵柯一众大臣顿时吓得心跳加速。　　什么叫我们明知道是一首抄袭的诗？我们不知道，我们哪里知道了？　　我们也是现在才知道的！　　没看到我们现在的震惊，并不比你少吗？　　再说我们要是知道那是抄袭的诗，我们还敢大张旗鼓跟你来沈园诗会决战吗？　　心头在怒吼，但群臣却没敢有半点不满，全都脸色煞白。　　皇帝在秋后算账。　　是他们做错了，得人，挨打要立正。　　谁让他们当时逼皇帝逼得那么狠，现在皇帝逮住机会了，能不收拾他们吗？　　“陛下恕罪！”　　群臣脑袋都贴在了地上。　　“恕罪？呵……”　　炎文帝看向唐逸，眨了眨眼道：“唐逸，他们欺君罔上，罪该万死，想要朕恕罪，你说……朕该如何处置？”　　唐逸正安静看戏，毕竟这场大戏，是他主导的。　　现在看到炎文帝冲着自己挤眉弄眼，唐逸嘴角不由微微抽搐。　　炎文帝这么问，显然是不想真将所有大臣给处置了，不然整个大炎朝廷会陷入瘫痪，这是想要给自己找台阶下。　　但朝中那么多大佬在场，随便一个人说话都比我有分量吧？　　你不找他们，你找我干嘛？现在就算我求情他们也不会领情。　　你这台阶，找错地方了。　　心头虽然暗暗吐槽，唐逸拱手道：“回陛下，既是欺君罔上，自当是死罪，理应全部诛之，一个不留！”　　炎文帝嘴角陡然一僵，啥？你是不是说错了？　　朕是这个意思吗？　　朕不是这个意思！　　大战在即，一下子全杀完了，谁来顶上？　　朕是让你假装劝朕，吓一吓他们，不是让你让朕下决心。　　群臣身体也都齐齐一颤，心头恨意滔天，可恶，你还真是恨我们不死啊！　　老将军狄苍看了一眼唐逸，差点没笑出声来，确定了，这小子生错了地方，应该是他们武将的崽才对。　　文官的那套虚情假意，他还真不屑去做。　　“陛下，老臣觉得小诗仙所言，不妥。”　　狄苍站了出来，拱手道：“陛下，如今北狄和大乾大战一触即发，正是用人之际。”　　“此时若是处置刘大人，唐大人他们，得意的只是北狄。”　　“老臣恳请陛下，饶他们一命。”　　炎文帝听到狄苍的话，当即瞪了唐逸一眼。　　看到了吧？这才是朕想让你说的。　　他当即冷哼一声，道：“看在老将军的份上，朕今日便饶你们一命，只罚俸两年为惩罚。”　　“但，驰援北境的物资和军械，三天内必须准备就绪运往北境。”　　“敢有半点拖延，一律按叛国罪论处！”　　叛国，诛九族！
content_en: Many people felt bad on the spot when they heard Tang Yin's childish voice.Is your brother very powerful?Your brother looked like he was half dead when he came in. Who would believe you if you said he was very powerful?Don’t you want to see who his opponent is?Those were the Tang paintings of the number one scholar in Sanyuan, as well as a group of scholars and talents who had just been named on the gold medal list.How can he alone be the opponent of so many people?As a result, Tang Yi knocked everyone down on the spot as soon as he came on stage and sang two lyrics!At this time, everyone looked at Tang Yin who looked proud, and everyone gritted their teeth. It turned out that this little girl said that her brother was very powerful when she came in. She was really not bragging, she was just stating a fact.His brother is indeed very powerful!"Yes, your brother is very powerful. No one is his opponent." Du Lingfei rubbed Tang Yin's head and also laughed.She didn't have that much confidence in Tang Yi before, but now it seems that her worries are in vain.He is right. If he takes action, others will not even have a chance to take action.This is not arrogance!It's a fact.At this time, Emperor Yanwen glanced across the entire audience, his eyes were cold, and the veins on his forehead were bulging.It looked like he was furious.​Actually, he wasn't angry, he just couldn't hold back his laughter.Although there is a certain discrepancy between the actual situation and his guess, this discrepancy is a good thing for him...Although he was embarrassed by Tang Hua's "Poetry of Remonstrance" that day, but now he sees Tang Jing, Liu Wen, Zhao Ke and other ministers so frightened and uneasy that they don't even dare to look at him... There is no anger in his heart, only comfort!Haha, did you see it?This is the little poetry fairy that I like, the person that I like.Aren’t you crazy?Don’t you like to criticize me?Even the poems you criticize me for are all written by my little poetry fairy. Why are you so arrogant?!Hahaha... hold it back, hold it back, I have been trained and must hold back from laughing.Unless you can't help it!"Hahaha..." Emperor Yanwen's laughter spread throughout the audience.However, upon hearing his laughter, the whole place fell into silence.His laughter is so magical, so magical that it makes people scared.Especially Liu Wen, Zhao Ke and other ministers, their scalps went numb instantly. It was over, His Majesty was angry.Emperor Yanwen smiled, looked at Tang Hua and said coldly: "Tang Hua, I will only ask you once...were the poems in the imperial examination plagiarized from Tang Yi's?" Tang Hua had long been frightened by Emperor Yanwen's laughter.Plop!His knees weakened and he knelt on the ground on the spot, kowtowing repeatedly."Your Majesty forgives me, Your Majesty spares my life, I... I was obsessed for a moment and used Tang Yi's poems." "Your Majesty, please forgive me, I don't dare to do it anymore..." Haha, it is indeed true, it is really the poems of that boy Tang Yi.Tsk tsk, if that’s the case then I’m not welcome!Whatever you old thieves did to me back then, I will pay you back today.Ahem, you can't be too happy, you have to pretend to be angry... Emperor Yanwen slowly raised his head and stared at the sky.When everyone saw his appearance, they were so frightened that they dared not speak out.After a moment, Emperor Yanwen flicked his sleeves, and a cold voice spread in the air."Okay, very good!" Emperor Yanwen stared at Liu Wen and Tang Jing and a group of ministers, and said: "Liu Aiqing, Tang Aiqing, you guys put on a good show! You played me around." "What a great number one scholar who can rival my little poetry fairy,What a genius who can write "Poems of Remonstrance" "Haha, you are teasing me so much, do you really think I dare not kill you?"Every word Emperor Yan Wen said was like a slap in the face of Tang Jing and Liu Wen.Liu Wen, Tang Jing and other ministers all knelt down instantly, their faces turned pale with fright."I will die ten thousand times, Your Majesty, please forgive me!" Emperor Yan Wen stared at them coldly and smiled mockingly."Death? How could you deserve to die? It's me who deserves to die!" "You used a plagiarized "Poetry of Remonstrance" to force me to negotiate peace with Beidi, and you spoke so righteously and confidently."If I don't listen, then I am a fool and have no regard for the country.""You are all loyal ministers, how can you die... Just die!"Emperor Yanwen said the following words very hard.Liu Wen, Zhao Ke and the other ministers were suddenly frightened and their hearts beat faster.What does it mean that we know it is a plagiarized poem?We don’t know, how do we know?We only know this now!Don’t you see that we are no less shocked than you are?Besides, if we knew that it was a plagiarized poem, would we still dare to come to the Shenyuan Poetry Club with you for a showdown?They were roaring in their hearts, but the ministers did not dare to be dissatisfied at all, and their faces were all pale.The emperor settles accounts after the autumn.It’s them who did something wrong, and they have to stand upright when they are beaten.Who told them to push the emperor so hard at that time? Now that the emperor has seized the opportunity, can he not deal with them?"Your Majesty, forgive me!" All the ministers' heads were on the ground."Forgive me? Ha..." Emperor Yan Wen looked at Tang Yi, blinked and said, "Tang Yi, they deceived you and ignored them. They deserve death. If you want me to forgive them, what do you think... how should I deal with it?" Tang Yi was watching the show quietly. After all, he was leading the show.Now seeing Emperor Yan Wen winking at him, the corners of Tang Yi's mouth couldn't help but twitch slightly.Emperor Yanwen asked this, obviously because he didn't want to really deal with all the ministers, otherwise the entire Great Yan court would be paralyzed. He wanted to find a way out for himself."But with so many big shots in the DPRK present, what anyone says has more weight than me, right?"If you don’t look for them, why are you looking for me?Even if I beg for mercy now, they won't appreciate it.You are looking for the wrong steps.Although he was complaining secretly in his heart, Tang Yi cupped his hands and said: "Your Majesty, since you have deceived the emperor and ignored your superiors, it should be a capital crime. All of them should be punished, no one spared!"
